name: Scantech (HANGZHOU) Co., Ltd.
summary: Scantech (HANGZHOU) Co., Ltd. provides 3D vision digital products and automated 3D vision inspection systems in China and internationally. The company offers handheld 3D vision digitalization products, including composite 3D scanner, smart handheld 3D scanner, global 3D scanner, Tracking 3D scanner, automated 3D visual inspection system, and color 3D scanner; tracking 3D system; and probing system. It also provides industrial-grade automated 3D laser measurement system; 3D software products; color 3D scanner products; and 3D solutions, 3D inspection, product development, automated 3D inspection, reverse engineering, and 3D printing and visualization solutions.
